meta.ci: percentile (lo/hi); BCa alongside (bca_lo/bca_hi, jackknife over resampled groups)
meta.resample_rule: coarsest group level with >= min_groups groups (TASK_LEVELS overrides the candidates); classification metrics with label-pure groups resampled within class strata, skipping a level where most strata hold a single group; else the next finer level, finally units. Every level is also reported under `levels`
meta.paired_rule: metric(a) - metric(b), a = mae_5src (same task/protocol; finetune for scratch), same resampled groups for both
